verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Unit exposes transaction data via API/dashboard with settlement-level visibility for payments, cards, and accounts (unit-docs-1, unit-docs-2, unit-docs-3, unit-docs-5), but none of the evidence specifically describes counterparty detail fields, rail-specific metadata schemas, stable transaction identifiers, or enrichment logic that would make a raw bank feed usable in-product. missing for 10: explicit documentation of counterparty data fields, rail-specific metadata, stable/idempotent transaction IDs, and enrichment/categorization features.
